description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter (NotesAdapter) for displaying a list of notes in an Android application. It manages note item views, handles item diffing for efficient updates, binds note data to views, and handles click events.

classes.name: NotesAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of Note objects, handles item diffing and user interactions.

classes.name: NotesAdapter.VH
classes.description: ViewHolder class holding references to the views within a note item layout.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ViewHolder object, inflating the note item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds note data to the ViewHolder views for display, sets click listener.
